about: R22 (HCFC-22) is a single-component refrigerant that was widely used in older split and window air conditioners and in cold-storage systems. It is being phased out under the Montreal Protocol because it depletes the ozone layer, and it is now used mainly to service existing equipment.
If your system is old, ask about servicing or retrofit options. Recovery and handling should be done by trained technicians.

faq.question: Is R22 (Chlorodifluoromethane) flammable?
faq.answer: R22 (Chlorodifluoromethane) is classified as non-flammable, but it is stored under pressure and can displace oxygen in enclosed spaces. Handle it through a trained technician with proper gauges, recovery equipment and ventilation.
